authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of DewasDoneDanuwar pãts “five” (f_uim5yvlrekpvm). Family evidence: CDIAL 7655 pañca explicitly gives Dardic panž/panz and Pashai paĩ/paẽ, alongside Kalasha poñ and Shina poĩ. The survey affricate-to-sibilant and contracted nasal/glide numerals fit this documented five family; exact local phonetic developments remain qualified. Reviewed comparison: Hajong pas “five” (f_qt3qktapu43dy). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
